name: E2E Flow Tests
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/e2e-flows.yml'
      - 'apps/web/__tests__/e2e/flows/**'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/e2e-flows.yml'
      - 'apps/web/__tests__/e2e/flows/**'

env:
  E2E_FLOWS_ENABLED: true
  NODE_VERSION: '20'
  PNPM_VERSION: '9'

jobs:
  e2e-flows:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: ${{ env.PNPM_VERSION }}
          run_install: false

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Setup ngrok tunnel
        uses: ngrok/github-action@v3
        with:
          authtoken: ${{ secrets.E2E_NGROK_AUTH_TOKEN }}
          tunnels: |
            addr=3000,proto=http

      - name: Start test server
        run: |
          pnpm dev &
          sleep 10

      - name: Run E2E flow tests
        run: |
          pnpm test-e2e:flows
        env:
          E2E_GMAIL_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.E2E_GMAIL_EMAIL }}
          E2E_OUTLOOK_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.E2E_OUTLOOK_EMAIL }}
          E2E_NGROK_TUNNEL_URL: ${{ steps.ngrok.outputs.url }}

      - name: Upload test results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: e2e-test-results
          path: |
            apps/web/__tests__/e2e/flows/test-results/
            apps/web/__tests__/e2e/flows/screenshots/
